provenance.normalization: UTF8 text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n'); preserve BOM/bare CR/Unicode/decoded literals
evidence: unchanged complete shared-contracts.ts with real locked Zod

r0fCoverage.comparison: returned scalar values exactly; rejected values by scalar classification/acceptance only; service-specific Nest error names/messages/status and full Zod issues are not implemented

groups.dateResults: businessDateOnly/costDate and costTimestamp; legacy input distinctions
groups.moneyResults: formatting/string passthrough and scalar finite/positive classification; service-specific Nest error wrapping not implemented
groups.schemaResults: 8 UUID/external ID cases; 2 required-nullable field cases belong to JSON adapters; 3 membership enum cases belong to generated shared contracts
groups.timestampResults: convert the timestamp fields; full session write snapshot/precedence not implemented

excluded.retentionResults: 4 business due-status cases; R1B does not implement Commission state decisions
excluded.repositoryResults: 10 SQL recording cases; R1B has no persistence

limitations: Rust legacy timestamp parsing covers the declared ISO/date-only forms under UTC; it is not arbitrary implementation-defined Date.parse or host-local parsing.
JS-valid dates outside chrono range return UnsupportedDateRange explicitly; public ISO date/UTC datetime schemas remain four-digit-year validators.
JS string.slice can create an isolated UTF16 surrogate; Rust date slicing rejects that boundary instead of silently replacing it. Complete surrogate pairs are tested.
No service calculation, session precedence/write snapshot, HTTP exception wrapping, database decoding, SQL, business transactions or full DTO migration is certified.
